reactions-grab: Chest catches a tether impact, torso recoils toward attacker on LEFT, feet skid LEFT while body still faces LEFT, stop near attacker. Hands react rather than attack.
Arms and torso tense as held around waist by an external attacker; four distinct struggling poses, head neck and shoulders anatomically aligned.
Waist grip lifts body, feet lose ground, body arches horizontally face up, settle into overhead held horizontal pose. Entire head rotates with shoulders.
Horizontal held pose transitions into forward tumbling, rotating head torso together, full body airborne fall ready for ground impact.
reactions-control: Incoming uppercut launches whole body, spine recoils, knees trail then tuck, airborne peak and falling pose.
Falling body rotates into back-first impact, natural bent knees, fully horizontal stunned ground pose and settled lying pose. Head lies with torso.

An outside cage restrains the character: start recoil, hands pushing invisible restraint, full-body struggling pose, released backward stagger. No cage drawn into sprite; separate effect layer supplies cage.
Outside magic lifts the character: start ankle lift, limbs trail with center of mass suspended, curved weightless recoil, falling recovery. No attacker, magic or second body drawn.

status: Reaction selection and movement are integrated in the game code. Artwork generation, sprite upload and paired visual review remain pending.
